OUR SIGNATURE PILLARS

Key Features of Shomoukh

01 / FEATURE

Home-like Environment

Warm, nurturing, and aesthetic spaces designed to feel like a natural, joyful second home for every child.

02 / FEATURE

Safe & Secure

Our standards are the highest in the industry, meeting and exceeding all local and international health & safety guidelines.

03 / FEATURE

Quality Educators

Dedicated early childhood professionals and researchers benefiting from continuous professional training and ongoing support.

04 / FEATURE

Play to Learn

WHO WE ARE

Welcome to Shomoukh Nursery Schools

Shomoukh Early Childhood Education is an International Early Years Nursery School, inspired by the Reggio Emilia approach, originated in Italy. In our school, children are viewed as unique, capable, resilient, creative, curious, and intelligent. We embrace everyone's culture while offering children a wide range of opportunities to become confident and prepare them to meet future challenges.

ETHOS & CULTURE

Our School's Philosophy

Our school's ethos and culture promote positive relations among its members and provides opportunities so that each child feels fulfilled, emphasizing social, emotional, and physical development.

PURPOSE & PROMISE

Our Mission

To provide high-quality childcare services and promote creativity and self-confidence in a positive, respectful learning environment that prepares children for lifelong learning.

VISION & VALUES

Our Vision & Values

Creating a happy environment that celebrates excellence in caring and development for every child as an individual, with optimistic community involvement and expert educators.

DISCOVER OUR PHILOSOPHY & PRINCIPLES
CURRICULUM & APPROACH

Our Promise to Families

At Shomoukh, we know childhood is a treasured time. We provide environments and experiences that capture the joys of childhood, nurture each child's individual growth, and pave the way for success in school and life.

Reggio Emilia

Thoughtfully and carefully designed nursery schools, programs, and schedules – all created with the needs of both children and parents in mind.

Inspired Teachers

Dedicated early childhood professionals fully engaged in teaching careers, who benefit from our continuous training and ongoing support.

Proven Approach to Education

UK Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) integrated with Reggio Emilia project inquiry, inspiring children to think critically on their own.

EXPLORE FULL PROGRAMS & EYFS CURRICULUM

We Meet Kids Where They Are

Shomoukh Early Childhood Education accommodates children aged 6 months to 4 years. Operating 12 months per year following a 3-term academic year and a fun-filled summer camp.

Infants (3–11 months)

Providing your baby's brain with a strong foundation for learning and growing.

Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Toddlers (12–35 months)

Exploring the world around them and forming positive relationships with peers and adults.

Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Preschoolers (36–48 months)

Developing confidence and problem-solving skills to meet complex future challenges.

Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Flex-Care (6–48 months)

Pre-Care & After-Care services to meet individual working family schedules.

Extended Hours: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM

SMART & INNOVATIVE LEARNING

Shomoukh Fun Space: Enrichments & Ateliers

Shomoukh ateliers are viewed as spaces where a group of children work together, using their imagination, creativity, and knowledge to experiment with different materials, technologies, and tools, under the encouragement and supervision of the Atelierista.

RESEARCH ATELIER

Clay Atelier

Experimenting with natural clay, soft and smooth textures, and sculpting tools.

EXPRESSION

Art Atelier

Multiple symbolic languages, stimulating colors, and creative materials.

INNOVATION

Digital & Light Atelier

Investigating light, analogical and digital tools, logic, and imagination.

EXPLORATION

Project Approach

Brainstorming and observations driven by children's individual interests.

PRETEND PLAY

Tiny Town

Interactive pretend play balancing personal ideas and social skills.

DEVELOPMENT

Sensory Play

Stimulating senses for brain growth, problem-solving, and language.

HARMONY

Music & Movement

Balancing body and mind while nurturing rhythm and latent talents.

CONFIDENCE

Drama & ECA / PE

Puppetry, story roleplay, physical education, and sports skills.

PURPOSE-BUILT ENVIRONMENT

Our Spaces: Designed for Discovery

Shomoukh nursery school is full of life. Spaces, areas, and corners around the school are designed with intention and purpose. They promote happiness, creativity, collaboration, and learning in the best way possible.

Art and Clay Ateliers

Hands-on research ateliers for tactile exploration, clay shaping, painting, and diverse symbolic expressions.

Digital / Light Atelier

Investigating light, shadows, projectors, optical logic, and creative digital learning strategies.

Drama Room

A dedicated space for puppetry, dramatic roleplay, storytelling, and expressive confidence.

Indoor Gymnasium

Climbers, balance tracks, and soft gym apparatus nurturing physical fitness and motor coordination.

Organic Garden

Children plant seeds, care for herbs, and discover natural life cycles and environmental sustainability.

Piazza (Central Square)

A central, open space where students, educators, and families can get together, interact, and collaborate.

ADMISSIONS PROCESS

Education for Your Child at Shomoukh

Admissions to Shomoukh Nursery School are offered on an ongoing basis, preferably at the start of the academic year. While most families complete registration during the fall and winter months, we continue to keep our programs open as long as space is available.

Join Our Diverse Community of Learners: Our admissions team at Shomoukh is looking forward to welcoming you and your child to our Shomoukh family. We offer quality education from ages 6 months to 6 years.

STEP 1

Book a Tour

Book a tour and visit Shomoukh nursery school together with your child during working hours.

Book a Visit Now
STEP 2

Submit Details

Upon confirmation, submit your details including your child's information and any required forms.

Apply Online Form
STEP 3

Secure Your Place

Proceed to term fee payments within the given time frame to secure your child's place.

Admissions Details
